verdict.rationale: Sentry's own alert docs say alert rules can call webhooks, so it does offer outbound HTTP callbacks triggered by matching issues. However, the evidence only shows this as one action of alert rules. It does not document a general event-subscription webhook system, and the Slack, PagerDuty and Splunk forwarding integrations do not count. Missing for 10: documentation of webhook endpoint registration, event types and payload schema, signing/verification and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
